directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to a foreign friend who wants to teach English in China. Please recommend a city to him. You should write at least 120 words but no more than] 80 words
sample_essay:
Dear [Friend's Name],

I'm thrilled to hear about your plan to teach English in China. I'd like to recommend Chengdu to you.

To begin with, Chengdu has a rich cultural heritage. You can visit the famous Wuhou Shrine, which commemorates the great statesman Zhuge Liang of the Three Kingdoms period. Moreover, the city is known for its delicious food. Spicy hot pot and mouth-watering snacks like dan dan noodles will surely satisfy your taste buds. In addition, the living cost in Chengdu is relatively reasonable. You can find a comfortable apartment at an affordable price, and daily expenses are not high.

In conclusion, Chengdu offers a great combination of culture, cuisine, and cost-effectiveness. I believe you'll have a wonderful time teaching there.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
